# Unified analyses
## 1. Differential gene expression analysis

### Pivot DEGs table
```{r fig.height=20, fig.width=20}
#Import datasets ==============
#DEGs (matched)
all_degs_human_mouse =
  readRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs_matched.rds"))
#DEGs (unmatched)
all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched =
  readRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))
#DEGs (matched with controls)
all_degs_human_mouse_matched_bionull =
  readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs_matched_control.rds"))

#Check
all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  dplyr::count(timepoint, organism, treatment, pathogen) 

#Functional modules
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "Gene sets", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

# Different timepoints, same species

human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_all = 

  #Condition 1
  all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen:human_symbol, mean_l2fc:sd, sd_sampling_stability) %>% 
  rename(mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc, p_adj = adj_p_val, 
    tstatistic = t, bstatistic = b) %>% 
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_1"), all_of(c("organism", "condition", "timepoint", "mean_log2fc", "ci_lower", "ci_upper", "ave_expr", "tstatistic", "p_value", "p_adj", "bstatistic", "se", "sd", "sd_sampling_stability"))) %>% 
  inner_join(
  #Condition 2
   all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched %>% 
  select(organism, pathogen:human_symbol, mean_l2fc:sd, sd_sampling_stability) %>% 
  rename(mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc, p_adj = adj_p_val, 
    tstatistic = t, bstatistic = b) %>% 
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_2"), all_of(c("organism", "condition", "timepoint", "mean_log2fc", "ci_lower", "ci_upper", "ave_expr", "tstatistic", "p_value", "p_adj", "bstatistic", "se", "sd", "sd_sampling_stability"))),
  
  by = join_by("pathogen", "treatment", "human_symbol")
  ) %>% 
  
  
  # Filter for strict 1:1 ortholog pairs with complete expression profiles
  drop_na(mean_log2fc_1, mean_log2fc_2) %>% 
  
  # Compute expression divergence and volatility metrics
  mutate(
    # Cross-species effect size delta (Directional macroevolutionary divergence)
    mean_log2fc_diff = mean_log2fc_1 - mean_log2fc_2,
    
    # Coefficient of Variation - CV
    # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    cv_1 = sd_1 / abs(mean_log2fc_1),
    cv_2 = sd_2 / abs(mean_log2fc_2),
    cv_mean  = (cv_1 + cv_2) / 2, # Combined cross-species relative noise
    
    # Statistical Weights for Downstream Weighted Correlation
    # Joint geometric weight based on downsampling iteration variance (SD^2)
    weight_sd_inverse = 1 / (sd_1^2 + sd_2^2),
    # Joint geometric weight based on native linear model standard error (SE^2)
    weight_se_inverse = 1 / (se_1^2 + se_2^2),
    
    se_combined = sqrt(se_1^2 + se_2^2),
    weight_se_inverse_combined = 1/(se_combined^2)
  ) %>% 
  
  
  #Factor reordering
    mutate(pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
       timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_1,  sep = "-", timepoint_2)) %>% 
  # filter(!c(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" & timepoint_mouse == "24h")) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_2 = as.character(timepoint_2),
         timepoint_2 = fct_relevel(timepoint_2, c("Early", "Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_1 = as.character(timepoint_1),
         timepoint_1 = fct_relevel(timepoint_1, c("Early", "Early hours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         treatment = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Hepatitis B", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",
                               pathogen %in% c( "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") ~ "Infection",
                               pathogen %in% c( "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Injury",
                               T ~ pathogen),
         treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury")) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint_1) %>%
  #Annotate Inter and intra-species comparisons
  mutate(comparison_set = case_when(organism_1 != organism_2 ~ "Inter-species",
                                    organism_1 == organism_2 ~ "Intra-species",
                                    T ~ NA)) 

#### Create Biological null distribution
biological_null_degs = readRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "duchenne_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds")) %>% 
  select(-comparison) %>% 
  rename(mean_log2fc = mean_l2fc, 
         p_adj = adj_p_val, 
         tstatistic = t, 
         bstatistic = b) %>% 
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_2"), all_of(c( "pathogen", "organism", "treatment", "condition", "timepoint", "mean_log2fc", "ci_lower", "ci_upper", "ave_expr", "tstatistic", "p_value", "p_adj", "bstatistic", "se", "sd")))

# Create Biological null distribution =====


# 1. Get the target data using the arguments
target_df <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_all %>%
  filter(organism_1 == "Human", organism_2 == "Mouse") %>%
  mutate(diff_mean_log2fc = mean_log2fc_1 - mean_log2fc_2, model_type = "Mouse") %>% 
  rename(pathogen_1 = pathogen, treatment_1 = treatment) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen_2 = pathogen_1, treament_2 = treatment_1)

# 2. Get the biological null data and join
null_df <- biological_null_degs %>%
  filter(condition_2 == "DMD_Day28") %>%
  inner_join(target_df %>% select(!ends_with("_2")), by = "human_symbol", suffix = c("_2", "_1")) %>%
  mutate(diff_mean_log2fc = mean_log2fc_1 - mean_log2fc_2,
         model_type = "Control") %>% 
  # Compute expression divergence and volatility metrics
  mutate(
    # Cross-species effect size delta 
    mean_log2fc_diff = mean_log2fc_1 - mean_log2fc_2,
    
    # Coefficient of Variation - CV
    cv_1 = sd_1 / abs(mean_log2fc_1),
    cv_2 = sd_2 / abs(mean_log2fc_2),
    cv_mean  = (cv_1 + cv_2) / 2,
    
    # Statistical Weights for Downstream Weighted Correlation
    weight_sd_inverse = 1 / (sd_1^2 + sd_2^2),
    weight_se_inverse = 1 / (se_1^2 + se_2^2),
    
    se_combined = sqrt(se_1^2 + se_2^2),
    weight_se_inverse_combined = 1/(se_combined^2)
  ) 

# 3. Return combined rows
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_interspecies_bionull = bind_rows(target_df,
                                                             null_df) %>% 
    #Rename 1 and 2 as human and mouse, respectively
     rename_with(
    ~ str_replace(.x, "_1$", "_human"), 
    ends_with("_1")
  ) %>% 
  rename_with(
    ~ str_replace(.x, "_2$", "_mouse"), 
    ends_with("_2")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_human,  sep = "-", timepoint_mouse),
         timepoint_comparison = str_replace_all(timepoint_comparison, "\n", " "), 
         pathogen_comparison = paste0(pathogen_human, "-", pathogen_mouse)) %>% 
  
  #Standardize factors
     mutate(
       #Human
         timepoint_human = str_replace(timepoint_human,"Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint_human = str_replace(timepoint_human,"Day ", "Day\n"),
         timepoint_human = fct_relevel(timepoint_human, c("Early\nhours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day\n1", "Day\n3", "Day\n7")),
         pathogen_human = case_when(pathogen_human == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen_human == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen_human == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~pathogen_human),
          pathogen_human = fct_relevel(pathogen_human, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         treatment_human = case_when(pathogen_human %in% c("HepB", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",
                               pathogen_human %in% c( "S. aureus", "E. coli") ~ "Infection",
                               pathogen_human %in% c( "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Injury",
                               T ~ pathogen_human),
         treatment_human = fct_relevel(treatment_human, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury"),
         
      #Mouse
         timepoint_mouse = str_replace(timepoint_mouse,"Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint_mouse = str_replace(timepoint_mouse,"Day ", "Day\n"),
         timepoint_mouse = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("Early\nhours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day\n1", "Day\n3", "Day\n7")),
         pathogen_mouse= case_when(pathogen_mouse == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen_mouse == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen_mouse == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~pathogen_mouse),
          pathogen_mouse = fct_relevel(pathogen_mouse, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         treatment_mouse = case_when(pathogen_mouse %in% c("HepB", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",
                               pathogen_mouse %in% c( "S. aureus", "E. coli") ~ "Infection",
                               pathogen_mouse %in% c( "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Injury",
                               T ~ pathogen_mouse),
         treatment_mouse = fct_relevel(treatment_mouse, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury")) %>% 
  #Categorize in difference in log2fc and sign difference
    
   mutate(  
    sign_human = case_when(
      mean_log2fc_human > 0 ~ "Pos.",
      mean_log2fc_human < 0 ~ "Neg.",
      TRUE                  ~ "Zero"
    ),
    sign_mouse = case_when(
      mean_log2fc_mouse > 0 ~ "Pos.",
      mean_log2fc_mouse < 0 ~ "Neg.",
      TRUE                  ~ "Zero"
    ),
    diff_sign_binary =  if_else(sign_human == sign_mouse, "Same", "Different"),
    diff_sign        = stringr::str_c(sign_human, "_", sign_mouse))

#Check
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_interspecies_bionull %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen_human, pathogen_mouse, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse, comparison_set)

human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_interspecies_bionull %>% 
  select(pathogen_human, pathogen_mouse, timepoint_comparison, model_type, human_symbol, mean_log2fc_diff) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(human_symbol == "IL7R") %>% 
  arrange(pathogen_human, pathogen_mouse)

#Get immune and non immune genes ==========
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune = 
  
  bind_rows(
    
  #All genes
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_interspecies_bionull %>%
  mutate(gene_set = "All genes"),
    
  #Same DEGs
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_interspecies_bionull %>%
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05) %>% 
  mutate(gene_set = "DEGs"), 
  
  #Classify as immune or non_immune 
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_interspecies_bionull %>% 
  mutate(gene_set = if_else(human_symbol %in% c(btm_annotation_genes %>%
                               filter(module_category == "immune") %>% 
                               pull(symbol)),
                             "Immune",
                             "Not-immune")) %>% 
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05 & p_adj_mouse <= 0.05)
  
  ) 


human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen_human, pathogen_mouse, comparison_set, model_type)

# #Save
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune %>%
  saveRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune.rds"))

```



### Distributions

#### Log2FC differences
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Import
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune = 
  readRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune.rds"))
#### Difference in means vs. status
log2fc_wide_allconditions_control =  
  
  bind_rows(
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune %>%
               filter(gene_set == "All genes") %>% 
               rename(pathogen = pathogen_human,
                      treatment = treatment_human, 
                      gene = human_symbol) %>% 
    filter(model_type == "Mouse") %>% 
    filter((pathogen == "E. coli" & timepoint_comparison == "24h-12h" |
            pathogen == "S. aureus" & timepoint_comparison == "24h-12h" |
            pathogen == "Burn" & timepoint_comparison == "Early hours-Day 7"|
            pathogen == "Trauma" & timepoint_comparison == "Day 7-Day 3"|
            pathogen == "Influenza" & timepoint_comparison == "Day 1-Day 7" |
            pathogen == "HepB" & timepoint_comparison == "Day 7-Day 7")),
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune %>%
               filter(gene_set == "All genes") %>% 
               rename(pathogen = pathogen_human,
                      treatment = treatment_human, 
                      gene = human_symbol) %>% 
    filter(model_type == "Control")
  )
  

# Calculate statistical significance tests per condition
stat_results <- log2fc_wide_allconditions_control %>%
  # Filter significant human DEGs (use drop_na to ensure valid filtering)
  filter(!is.na(p_adj_human) & p_adj_human <= 0.05) %>%
  mutate(abs_diff = abs(mean_log2fc_diff)) %>%
  group_by(treatment, pathogen) %>%
  summarise(
    # Match exact factor levels present in your model_type column
    n_target      = sum(model_type == "Mouse" & !is.na(abs_diff)),
    n_control     = sum(model_type == "Control" & !is.na(abs_diff)),
    
    median_target = if (n_target > 0) median(abs_diff[model_type == "Mouse"], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    median_null   = if (n_control > 0) median(abs_diff[model_type == "Control"], na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
    
    # Run Wilcoxon test safely
    wilcox_p      = if (n_target >= 1 && n_control >= 1) {
      wilcox.test(
        abs_diff[model_type == "Mouse"],
        abs_diff[model_type == "Control"],
        alternative = "less"
      )$p.value
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    fdr_wilcox = p.adjust(wilcox_p, method = "BH"),
    fdr_wilcox_sci = sprintf("%.2e", fdr_wilcox)
  )

# Inspect statistical summary table
print(stat_results)

#Plot
log2fc_distribution_control_condition_plot = log2fc_wide_allconditions_control %>%
  filter(p_adj_human <= 0.05) %>% 
  inner_join(stat_results,
             join_by(pathogen, treatment)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(
    x     = abs(mean_log2fc_diff),
    color = model_type,
    fill = model_type
  ) +
  # Create nested wrap facets across treatment and pathogen strata
  facet_nested_wrap(
    ~ treatment + pathogen + paste0("padj = ", fdr_wilcox_sci),
    nrow   = 1,
  ) +
  # Render density curves with linewidth formatting
  geom_density(
    linewidth = 1,
    data = . %>% filter(model_type == "Mouse")
  ) +
  geom_density(
    linewidth = 1,
    data = . %>% filter(model_type == "Control")
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(y = -0.1),
               width = 0.2, 
               outliers = F,
               color = "black") +
  # Restrict magnitude range to [0, 2] for maximum resolution
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.05, 0.05)) +
  # Set manual color palette for model types
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Control" = "black",
      "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF"
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Control" = NA,
      "Mouse" = "#4DBBD5FF"
    )
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.7, "cm"),
        plot.margin          = ggplot2::margin(0.1, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, "cm"),
        axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.1, color = "black"))  +
  labs(x = "|ΔLog2FC|",
       y = "Density",
       fill = "Model",
       color = "Model")

#Print
log2fc_distribution_control_condition_plot 

#Save
log2fc_distribution_control_condition_plot %>%
  ggsave(filename = here("Figures", "all_human_mouse_dge_degs_log2fcdiff_distribution.png"),
         width = 12,
         height = 3)
```

#### Log2FC diff vs. 1/SE
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=4.5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

## 1. Base filtrada
df_base <- log2fc_wide_effect_error_plot_df_pooled %>% 
  select(treatment, pathogen, timepoint_comparison, is_deg, diff_sign_binary, mean_log2fc_diff, se_mouse, weight_se_inverse_combined) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(treatment == "Pooled")

# 2. Criar estatísticas incluindo o grupo geral "All genes"
cor_stats <- bind_rows(
    df_base,
    df_base %>% mutate(is_deg = "All genes")
  ) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(x_val = 1 / se_mouse, y_val = abs(mean_log2fc_diff)) %>%
  group_by(treatment, pathogen, is_deg) %>% 
  cor_test(vars = "x_val", vars2 = "y_val", method = "spearman") %>%
  mutate(
    p_format = case_when(
      p < 2.2e-16 ~ "p < 2.2e-16",
      TRUE        ~ paste0("p = ", sprintf("%.2e", p))
    ),
    label_text = paste0("ρ=", round(cor, 2), ", ", p_format),
    # Reordena para "All genes" aparecer no topo/primeiro na pilha do gráfico
    is_deg = fct_relevel(as.factor(is_deg), "All genes") 
  )



# 2. Plotar o gráfico e adicionar as legendas de correlação com geom_label
log2fc_wide_effect_error_plot <- df_base %>% 
  bind_rows(df_base %>%  mutate(is_deg = "All genes")) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = 1 / se_mouse,
    y = abs(mean_log2fc_diff),
    color = is_deg,
    fill = is_deg
  )) +

  facet_nested_wrap(~ treatment + pathogen, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  # Group-specific Linear Regressions
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    mapping = aes(color = is_deg, fill = is_deg),
    se = TRUE
  ) +
   geom_text(
    data = cor_stats,
    aes(
      x = 1,              
      y = 0.2,          
      label = label_text,
      color = is_deg
    ),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1.2 + (as.numeric(as.factor(cor_stats$is_deg)) * 1.5), 
    # color = "black",
    size = 3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE     
  )+

  # Scales & Formatting
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, NA)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$degs_comparison_line) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$degs_comparison_line) +
  labs(
    x = "1/SE (mouse)",
    y = "|ΔLog2FC|",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.7, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = "none",
    fill = guide_legend(
      title.position = "top",
      # byrow = TRUE,
      # nrow = 1,
      override.aes = list(shape = 22, alpha = 1, size = 3, linetype = 0)
    )
  )
```

Boxplots
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=12}
#Plot as boxplot + violin
# 1. Calcular os p-valores ajustados por facet/grupo
stat_test <- log2fc_wide_effect_error_plot_df_pooled %>%
  mutate(inverse_se_mouse = 1/se_mouse) %>% 
  group_by(treatment, pathogen) %>%
  rstatix::wilcox_test(
    inverse_se_mouse ~ is_deg, 
    ref.group = "DEG, both", 
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
  rstatix::add_y_position(fun = "max", step.increase = 0.1)

# 2. Plotar o gráfico utilizando os resultados do teste
error_plot_df_boxplot = log2fc_wide_effect_error_plot_df_pooled %>% 
  mutate(inverse_se_mouse = 1/se_mouse) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(
    y     = inverse_se_mouse,
    x     = is_deg,
    color = is_deg,
    fill  = is_deg
  ) +
  facet_nested_wrap(
    ~ treatment + pathogen,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  geom_violin(width = 1, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = NA, outliers = FALSE, width = 0.1, show.legend = F) +
  
  # Adiciona os p-valores posicionados corretamente sobre cada barra/grupo
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_test,
    label           = "p.adj", # Usa asteriscos (ou "p.adj" para números)
    tip.length      = 0.01,
    hide.ns         = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$degs_comparison) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors$degs_comparison_boxplot) +
  
  # Aumenta o espaço superior no eixo Y para caber os testes sem cortar no facet
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) + 
  
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    x = "Filter",
    y = "1/SE, Mouse"
  )
```

#### Difference in Log2FC and sign
```{r fig.height=4, fig.width=12, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1. Prepare data and append the "Pooled" summary group
plot_data_sign <- log2fc_wide_allconditions %>% 
  filter(
    (pathogen == "E. coli" & timepoint_comparison == "24h-12h") |
    (pathogen == "S. aureus" & timepoint_comparison == "24h-12h") |
    (pathogen == "Burn" & timepoint_comparison == "Early hours-Day 7") |
    (pathogen == "Trauma" & timepoint_comparison == "Day 7-Day 3") |
    (pathogen == "Influenza" & timepoint_comparison == "Day 1-Day 7") |
    (pathogen == "HepB" & timepoint_comparison == "Day 7-Day 7")
  ) %>% 
  select(
    treatment, pathogen, timepoint_comparison, is_deg, 
    diff_sign_binary, mean_log2fc_diff, weight_se_inverse_combined
  ) %>%
  distinct()

plot_data_sign_pooled <- plot_data_sign %>% 
  bind_rows(
    plot_data_sign %>% 
      mutate(treatment = "Pooled", pathogen = "", timepoint_comparison = "")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury", "Pooled"))

# 2. Build the plot
log2fc_wide_effect_sign_plot <- plot_data_sign_pooled %>% 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = is_deg,
    y = weight_se_inverse_combined
  )) +
  facet_nested_wrap(
    ~ treatment + pathogen + timepoint_comparison, 
    nrow = 1, 
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(
      fill = diff_sign_binary,
      group = interaction(is_deg, diff_sign_binary)
    ),
    alpha = 1, 
    outliers = FALSE,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors$direction) +
  labs(
    fill = "Directional Sign",
    x = "",
    y = "1/combinedSE"
  ) +
  theme_vaxgo() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      title.position = "left",
      byrow = TRUE,
      nrow = 1,
      override.aes = list(shape = 22, alpha = 1, size = 3)
    )
  )

# Display Plot
log2fc_wide_effect_sign_plot +
  # Statistical test layer (within-group comparison between fill levels per x-axis category)
  stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = diff_sign_binary, label = ..p.adj..),
    method = "wilcox.test",
    p.adjust.method = "BH",
    hide.ns = TRUE,
    size = 2.5,
    vjust = -0.5, 
  )
```

### Overlapping DEGs

```{r}
#Import datasets
all_degs_human_mouse = readRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs_matched.rds"))

all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched = readRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "Gene sets", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))
```


Unmatched timepoints
```{r}
# 1. Data Preparation (single cleanup step)

degs_summary <- all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>%
    mutate(pathogen = recode(pathogen, 
                           "Staphylococcus aureus" = "S. aureus",
                           "Escherichia coli" = "E. coli",
                           "Hepatitits B" = "HepB")) %>%
  select(human_symbol, pathogen, timepoint, organism) %>%
  distinct()

all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched_ndegs = degs_summary %>%
  group_by(pathogen, organism,  timepoint) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n())

# 2. Identify overlap 
# Create a table that indicates if a gene is a DEG in each organism
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary = degs_summary %>%
  filter(organism == "Human") %>%
  full_join(
    degs_summary %>% 
      filter(organism == "Mouse"),
    by = c("human_symbol", "pathogen"),
    suffix = c("_human", "_mouse")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      !is.na(organism_human) & !is.na(organism_mouse) ~ "Shared",
      !is.na(organism_human) & is.na(organism_mouse)  ~ "Human\nonly",
      is.na(organism_human) & !is.na(organism_mouse)  ~ "Mouse\nonly"
    )
  ) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse, status) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(timepoint_mouse = if_else(is.na(timepoint_mouse), "Not\nShared", timepoint_mouse),
         timepoint_human = if_else(is.na(timepoint_human), "Not\nShared", timepoint_human))
  
#Calculate background number of genes
background_n <- all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched %>%
  select(human_symbol, organism, pathogen) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(human_symbol) %>%
  filter(n() == 2) %>% 
  nrow()


#Unite human
  
# 1. Preparar a tabela de totais de uma vez só
total_genes <- all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched_ndegs %>%
  mutate(organism = str_to_lower(organism)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = organism, 
    values_from = n_genes, 
    names_prefix = "n_genes_total_"
  ) %>%
  # Preenche os NAs para garantir que os totais estejam disponíveis
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  fill(n_genes_total_human, n_genes_total_mouse, .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Preparar a base de sobreposição
shared_genes <- degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary %>%
  filter(status == "Shared") %>%
  rename(n_genes_shared = n_genes) %>% 
  select(-status) %>% 
  distinct()

# 3. Join unificado
all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched_shared <- shared_genes %>%
  left_join(total_genes %>% 
              select(pathogen, timepoint, n_genes_total_human), by = c("pathogen", "timepoint_human" = "timepoint")) %>%
  left_join(total_genes %>% select(pathogen, timepoint, n_genes_total_mouse), by = c("pathogen", "timepoint_mouse" = "timepoint")) %>%
  # Limpeza final das colunas redundantes geradas pelo join
  select(pathogen, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse, 
         n_genes_shared, 
         n_genes_total_human, 
         n_genes_total_mouse) %>% 
  mutate(pct_shared_mouse = ((n_genes_shared/n_genes_total_mouse) *100) %>% round(0),
         pct_shared_human = ((n_genes_shared/n_genes_total_human) *100) %>% round(0)) %>% 
  #Factor cleaning
  mutate(pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", 
                                  "S. aureus", "E. coli", 
                                  "Burn", "Trauma"),
         treatment = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Hepatitis B", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",
                               pathogen %in% c( "S. aureus", "E. coli") ~ "Infection",
                               pathogen %in% c( "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Injury",
                               T ~ pathogen),
         treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury"), 
       
       #Break timepoint spaces
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_mouse,  sep = "-", timepoint_human),
         timepoint_mouse = as.character(timepoint_mouse),
         timepoint_human = as.character(timepoint_human),
         timepoint_human = str_replace(timepoint_human,"Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint_human = str_replace(timepoint_human,"Day ", "Day\n"),
         timepoint_human = fct_relevel(timepoint_human, c("Human\nonly", "Early\nhours", 
                                                          "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h",
                                                          "Day\n1", "Day\n3", "Day\n7")),
#Mouse
         timepoint_mouse = str_replace(timepoint_mouse,"Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint_mouse = str_replace(timepoint_mouse,"Day ", "Day\n"),
         timepoint_mouse = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("Mouse\nonly", "Early\nhours", 
                                                          "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h",
                                                          "Day\n1", "Day\n3", "Day\n7"))
         ) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint_mouse)
```

Matched timepoints
```{r}
# 1. Data Preparation (single cleanup step)
degs_summary <- all_degs_human_mouse %>%
  mutate(pathogen = recode(pathogen, 
                           "Staphylococcus aureus" = "S. aureus",
                           "Escherichia coli" = "E. coli",
                           "Hepatitits B" = "HepB")) %>%
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>%
  # Keep only essential columns
  select(human_symbol, pathogen, timepoint, timepoint_comparison, organism) %>%
  distinct()

# 2. Identify overlap intelligently
# Create a table that indicates if a gene is a DEG in each organism
overlap_status <- degs_summary %>%
  separate(timepoint_comparison, into = c("timepoint_mouse", "timepoint_human"), 
           sep = "-", remove = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, 
           timepoint_mouse,
           timepoint_human,
           human_symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    is_human = any(organism == "Human"),
    is_mouse = any(organism == "Mouse"),
    .groups = "drop", 
  ) %>%
  mutate(condition_new = case_when(
    is_human & is_mouse ~ "Shared",
    is_human            ~ "Human only",
    is_mouse            ~ "Mouse only"
  )) %>% 
  group_by(pathogen, condition_new,
           timepoint_mouse, timepoint_human) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") 


# 3. Final Summary
degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary <- overlap_status %>%
  filter(!c(pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" & timepoint_mouse == "24h")) %>% 
  
  #Factor cleaning
  mutate(condition_new = fct_relevel(condition_new,  "Human only",  "Mouse only", "Shared"),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", 
                                  "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", 
                                  "Burn", "Trauma"),
       timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_mouse,  sep = "-", timepoint_human)) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_mouse = as.character(timepoint_mouse),
         timepoint_mouse = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("Early", 
                                                          "Early hours", 
                                                          "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", 
                                                          "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_human = as.character(timepoint_human),
         timepoint_human = fct_relevel(timepoint_human, c("Early", 
                                                          "Early hours", 
                                                          "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", 
                                                          "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         treatment = case_when(pathogen %in% c("Hepatitis B", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",
                               pathogen %in% c( "S. aureus", "E. coli") ~ "Infection",
                               pathogen %in% c( "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Injury",
                               T ~ pathogen),
         treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury")) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint_mouse)


# 4. Range calculation (kept as requested)
ranges_y <- degs_human_mouse_overlap_genes_summary %>%
  group_by(pathogen) %>%
  summarise(max = max(n))
```

## 2. Gene expression correlation analysis

### 2.1. Correlation: Genes, means, Overall

#### Pivot DEGs table
```{r fig.height=20, fig.width=20}
#Import datasets ==============
#DEGs (matched)
all_degs_human_mouse =
  readRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs_matched.rds"))
#DEGs (unmatched)
all_degs_human_mouse_unmatched =
  readRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_dge_limma_degs.rds"))

#Check
all_degs_human_mouse %>% 
  dplyr::count(timepoint, organism, treatment, pathogen) 

#Functional modules
btm_annotation_genes = read_csv(file = here("tables", "Gene sets", "btm_annotation_genes.csv"))

human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune =
  readRDS(here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune.rds"))

```









#### Compute correlation
```{r fig.height=20, fig.width=20}
#####################
#Correlation (Weighted)
#####################

# Inter-species ==========
correlation_filtered_inter_weighted =      
  human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune %>%
  filter(comparison_set == "Inter-species") %>% 
  group_by(comparison_set, treatment_human, treatment_mouse, pathogen_human, pathogen_mouse, 
           timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse, model_type,
           gene_set) %>%
  summarise({
    # Compute weighted correlation
    res <- wtd.cor(x = rank(mean_log2fc_human), 
                   y = rank(mean_log2fc_mouse), 
                   weight = weight_se_inverse)
    
    # Extract statistics
    data.frame(
      rho = res[1, "correlation"],
      se  = res[1, "std.err"],
      t   = res[1, "t.value"],
      p   = res[1, "p.value"],
      n_genes   = n()
    )
  }, .groups = 'drop')  %>% 
  mutate(
    #Significance
    p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"),
    p_adj_label = case_when(
      is.na(p_adj)      ~ "ns",
      p_adj <= 0.01     ~ "***",
      p_adj <= 0.05     ~ "**",
      p_adj <= 0.10     ~ "*",
      TRUE                ~ "ns"
    ),
    label = paste0("rho=", round(rho, 2), ", n=", n_genes, ", ", p_adj_label)
  ) %>% 
  
  #Standardize factors
     mutate(
       comparison = "Human vs. Mouse",
       timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_human, sep = "-", timepoint_mouse),
       timepoint_comparison = str_replace_all(timepoint_comparison, "\n", " "),
       pathogen_comparison = paste0(pathogen_human, "-", pathogen_mouse),
       
       #Human
         timepoint_human = str_replace(timepoint_human,"Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint_human = str_replace(timepoint_human,"Day ", "Day\n"),
         timepoint_human = fct_relevel(timepoint_human, c("Early\nhours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day\n1", "Day\n3", "Day\n7")),
         pathogen_human = case_when(pathogen_human == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen_human == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen_human == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~pathogen_human),
          pathogen_human = fct_relevel(pathogen_human, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         treatment_human = case_when(pathogen_human %in% c("HepB", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",
                               pathogen_human %in% c( "S. aureus", "E. coli") ~ "Infection",
                               pathogen_human %in% c( "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Injury",
                               T ~ pathogen_human),
         treatment_human = fct_relevel(treatment_human, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury"),
         
      #Mouse
         timepoint_mouse = str_replace(timepoint_mouse,"Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint_mouse = str_replace(timepoint_mouse,"Day ", "Day\n"),
         timepoint_mouse = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("Early\nhours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day\n1", "Day\n3", "Day\n7")),
         pathogen_mouse= case_when(pathogen_mouse == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen_mouse == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen_mouse == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~pathogen_mouse),
          pathogen_mouse = fct_relevel(pathogen_mouse, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         treatment_mouse = case_when(pathogen_mouse %in% c("HepB", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",
                               pathogen_mouse %in% c( "S. aureus", "E. coli") ~ "Infection",
                               pathogen_mouse %in% c( "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Injury",
                               T ~ pathogen_mouse),
         treatment_mouse = fct_relevel(treatment_mouse, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury")) 

#Check
correlation_filtered_inter_weighted %>% 
  dplyr::count(pathogen_human, pathogen_mouse, timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse)

#Save
correlation_filtered_inter_weighted %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_correlation_filtered_inter_weighted.rds"))

#Summary
degs_immune_nonimmune_summary = human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune %>%
  filter(comparison_set == "Inter-species") %>%  
  group_by(pathogen_human, pathogen_mouse, timepoint_comparison, gene_set) %>% 
  summarise(n_genes = n(), .groups = "drop")

#Filter comparisons with highest correlation ==============
correlation_filtered_inter_weighted_top = correlation_filtered_inter_weighted %>% 
  filter(gene_set == "DEGs") %>% 
  group_by(treatment_human, treatment_mouse, 
           pathogen_human, pathogen_mouse) %>% 
  slice_max(rho, n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

correlation_filtered_inter_weighted_filtered = correlation_filtered_inter_weighted %>% 
  inner_join(correlation_filtered_inter_weighted_top %>% 
               select(pathogen_human, pathogen_mouse, 
                      timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse),
             by = join_by(pathogen_human, pathogen_mouse, 
                          timepoint_human, timepoint_mouse))

#Save
correlation_filtered_inter_weighted_filtered %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_correlation_filtered_inter_weighted_filtered.rds"))


#Annotate facets  ==============
cor_data_facetted <- correlation_filtered_inter_weighted_filtered %>% 
  mutate(
    gene_set = factor(gene_set, levels = c("All genes", "DEGs", "Not-immune", "Immune")),
    facet_label = paste0(gene_set, ": ", label)) %>% 
  arrange(gene_set) %>% 
   group_by(pathogen_human, pathogen_mouse, timepoint_comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    facet_label = paste(facet_label, collapse = "\n"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )  %>% 
  mutate(facet_label = paste0(timepoint_comparison, "\n", facet_label)) %>% 
  arrange(timepoint_comparison) %>% 
  mutate(facet_label = fct_inorder(facet_label),
         pathogen_comparison = paste0(pathogen_human, " vs. ", pathogen_mouse)) %>% 
  arrange(pathogen_human) 

#Join with Expression data
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_labels = human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_interspecies_bionull %>% 
  select(-pathogen_comparison) %>% 
  inner_join(cor_data_facetted , 
             by = join_by(pathogen_human, pathogen_mouse, timepoint_comparison)) %>% 
  mutate(pathogen_human = fct_relevel(pathogen_human, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma")) %>% 
  distinct() 

#Save
human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_labels %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "Differential gene expression", "all_human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_labels.rds"))



```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=11}
#Import correlation
correlation_filtered_inter_weighted =

# Plot Matrices
# All
correlation_heatmap_all = correlation_filtered_inter_weighted %>% 
  filter(pathogen_mouse != "DMD") %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint_mouse,
      y = timepoint_human) +
  #Facet
    facet_nested_wrap(~gene_set+treatment_mouse+pathogen_mouse,
                    scales = "free",
                    nrow = 4, 
                    axes = "all",
                    remove_labels = "none",
                    strip = strip_nested(size = "variable")) +
  labs(x = "Mouse",
       y = "Human") +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = rho)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(rho, 2)), size = 3, 
                  color = "black") +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
        colors = c("#4DBBD5FF", "white","#4361ee"),
        values = scales::rescale(seq(-1, 1, length.out = 10)),
        limits = c(-1, 1),
        name = "Spearman's rho",
        guide = guide_colorbar(
          barwidth = 15,
          barheight = 1,
```

##### Intraspecies

All
```{r fig.height=12, fig.width=18}
# Intra-species ==========
correlation_filtered_intra_weighted <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_degs_all_immune_nonimmune %>%
  filter(comparison_set == "Intra-species") %>% 
  group_by(
    comparison_set, organism_1, treatment, pathogen,
    timepoint_1, timepoint_2, gene_set
  ) %>%
  summarise({
    # Capture the data for the current group
    d <- cur_data()
    
    # Clean: filter out NAs and invalid weights
    valid_data <- d %>% 
      filter(!is.na(mean_log2fc_1), 
             !is.na(mean_log2fc_2), 
             weight_se_inverse > 0)
    
    # Check if we have enough observations (e.g., at least 3)
    if (nrow(valid_data) >= 3) {
      res <- wtd.cor(
        x = rank(valid_data$mean_log2fc_1), 
        y = rank(valid_data$mean_log2fc_2), 
        weight = valid_data$weight_se_inverse
      )
      
      data.frame(
        rho = res[1, "correlation"],
        se  = res[1, "std.err"],
        t   = res[1, "t.value"],
        p   = res[1, "p.value"]
      )
    } else {
      # Return NAs if the group is too small or invalid
      data.frame(rho = NA, se = NA, t = NA, p = NA)
    }
  }, .groups = 'drop') %>% 
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism_1, " vs. ", organism_1),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint_1, "-", timepoint_2)) %>%

  #Standardize factors
  mutate(timepoint_label = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"),
                                   timepoint_2, timepoint_1),
         timepoint_label = as.character(timepoint_label),
         timepoint_label = str_replace(timepoint_label,"Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint_1 = str_replace(timepoint_1,"Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint_2 = str_replace(timepoint_2,"Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint_2 = str_replace(timepoint_2,"Day ", "Day\n"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint_label, c("Early\nhours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_1 = fct_relevel(timepoint_1, c("Early\nhours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_2 = fct_relevel(timepoint_2, c("Early\nhours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day\n1", "Day\n3", "Day\n7")),
         pathogen = as.character(pathogen),
         pathogen = case_when(pathogen == "Hepatitis B" ~ "HepB",
                              pathogen == "Staphylococcus aureus" ~ "S. aureus",
                              pathogen == "Escherichia coli" ~ "E. coli",
                              T ~pathogen),
          pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         treatment = case_when(pathogen %in% c("HepB", "Influenza") ~ "Vaccination",
                               pathogen %in% c( "S. aureus", "E. coli") ~ "Infection",
                               pathogen %in% c( "Burn", "Trauma") ~ "Injury",
                               T ~ pathogen),
         treatment = fct_relevel(treatment, "Vaccination", "Infection", "Injury"))
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=16}
human_mouse_log2fc_log2fc_avg_wide_scatterplot = human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide_labels_filters %>% 
  mutate(comparison_facet = if_else(str_detect(pathogen_comparison, "DMD"), "Control", "Experiment"),

  #Plot
```

By pathogen, all vs all.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Hmisc)
library(here)
library(janitor)

# 1. Define Inputs and Gene Subsets -----------------------------------------
# We create a list to automate the loop over both sets
gene_sets_list <- list(
  "AllGenes" = human_mouse_log2fc_samples,
  "Immune"   = human_mouse_log2fc_samples %>% 
                 filter(human_symbol %in% (btm_annotation_genes %>% 
                                          filter(module_category == "immune") %>% 
                                          pull(symbol) %>% unique()))
)


# 2. Main Processing Loop ----------------------------------------------------
# map_dfr iterates through "AllGenes" and "Immune", stacking the results
final_correlations <- map_dfr(names(gene_sets_list), function(set_name) {
  
  message(paste("Processing gene set:", set_name))
  current_data <- gene_sets_list[[set_name]]
  
  # Data Preparation: Long format to Wide Matrix
  genes_samples_long <- current_data %>%
    select(pathogen, organism, human_symbol, participant_id, timepoint, log2fc) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(condition = paste0(pathogen, "_", participant_id, "_", timepoint))

  samples_annotation <- genes_samples_long %>%
    select(pathogen, organism, participant_id, timepoint, condition) %>%
    distinct() 

  genes_samples_wide <- genes_samples_long %>%
    select(human_symbol, condition, log2fc) %>% 
    distinct() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = "condition", values_from = "log2fc", values_fn = mean) %>%
    column_to_rownames("human_symbol")

  # 3. Pathogen-Specific Correlation Calculation -----------------------------
  pathogen_list <- unique(samples_annotation$pathogen)
  
  map_dfr(pathogen_list, function(path) {
    
    pathogen_samples <- samples_annotation %>% 
      filter(pathogen == path) %>% 
      pull(condition) 
    
    # Subset matrix and drop NAs
    matrix_subset <- genes_samples_wide %>%
      select(all_of(intersect(pathogen_samples, colnames(.)))) %>%
      # drop_na() %>%
      as.matrix()
    
    if(nrow(matrix_subset) <= 4 | ncol(matrix_subset) < 2) {
      warning(paste("Skipping pathogen:", path, "- only", nrow(matrix_subset), "shared genes found."))
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Calculate Spearman Correlation
    cor_obj <- rcorr(matrix_subset, type = "spearman")
    
    # Tidy extraction of Rho and P-values
    r_long <- as.data.frame(cor_obj$r) %>%
      rownames_to_column("condition1") %>%
      pivot_longer(-condition1, names_to = "condition2", values_to = "rho")
    
    p_long <- as.data.frame(cor_obj$P) %>%
      rownames_to_column("condition1") %>%
      pivot_longer(-condition1, names_to = "condition2", values_to = "p_val")
    
    # Join with Metadata and Filter Duplicates
    r_long %>%
      left_join(p_long, by = c("condition1", "condition2")) %>%
      filter(condition1 < condition2) %>%
      left_join(samples_annotation %>% select(condition, organism1 = organism, timepoint1 = timepoint), 
                by = c("condition1" = "condition")) %>%
      left_join(samples_annotation %>% select(condition, organism2 = organism, timepoint2 = timepoint), 
                by = c("condition2" = "condition")) %>%
      mutate(pathogen = path, gene_set = set_name)
  })
})

# 4. Statistical Summary per Comparison and Timepoint -----------------------
correlation_summary <- final_correlations %>% 
  # Keep Human as reference for cross-species comparisons
  filter(!(organism1 == "Mouse" & organism2 == "Human")) %>% 
  mutate(comparison = paste0(organism1, " vs. ", organism2),
         timepoint_comparison = paste0(timepoint1, "-", timepoint2)) %>% 
  group_by(gene_set, pathogen, comparison, timepoint1, timepoint2) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_rho = mean(rho, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rho   = sd(rho, na.rm = TRUE),
    n        = n(),
    se       = sd_rho / sqrt(n),
    ci_low   = mean_rho - (qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se),
    ci_high  = mean_rho + (qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 5. Final Filtering (Matched Timepoints and 24h Reference) -----------------
correlation_summary_filtered <- bind_rows(
  # Matched timepoints (e.g., 2h vs 2h)
  correlation_summary %>% 
    filter(!(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli") & comparison == "Human vs. Mouse"),
           timepoint1 == timepoint2),
  
  # 24h reference for acute infections
  correlation_summary %>% 
    filter(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"),
           comparison == "Human vs. Mouse",
           timepoint1 == "24h")
) %>%
  mutate(timepoint_label = if_else(pathogen %in% c("Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli"), 
                                   timepoint2, timepoint1),
         timepoint_label = as.character(timepoint_label),
         timepoint_label = str_replace(timepoint_label,"Early hours", "Early\nhours"),
         timepoint = fct_relevel(timepoint_label, c("Early\nhours", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
          pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         gene_set = str_replace(gene_set, "AllGenes", "All genes")) 

correlation_summary_filtered
# Save Output
saveRDS(correlation_summary_filtered, file = here("tables", paste0(filename, "_gene_sets_correlation_summary.rds")))
```

### 2.3. Correlation: RRHO, means

```{r}
# 1. Identify all unique pathogen and timepoint combinations
combinations <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  distinct(pathogen, timepoint_comparison)

# 2. Initialize a list to store results from each iteration
all_rrho_results <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(combinations)) {
  
  curr_pathogen <- combinations$pathogen[i]
  curr_timepoint <- combinations$timepoint_comparison[i]
  
  # A. Filter and Prepare Differential Expression (DDE) Scores
  rrho_input_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
    filter(pathogen == curr_pathogen, timepoint_comparison == curr_timepoint) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_adj_human), !is.na(p_adj_mouse), 
           !is.na(mean_log2fc_human), !is.na(mean_log2fc_mouse)) %>%
    mutate(
      # Handle p-values of 0 to avoid infinite logs
      p_adj_human = ifelse(p_adj_human == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_adj_human),
      p_adj_mouse = ifelse(p_adj_mouse == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_adj_mouse),
      # Calculate DDE score: -log10(p-value) * sign of Fold Change
      score_human = -log10(p_adj_human) * sign(mean_log2fc_human),
      score_mouse = -log10(p_adj_mouse) * sign(mean_log2fc_mouse)
    )

  # Skip if the gene list is too small (RRHO2 requires a minimum set)
  if(nrow(rrho_input_data) < 100) next 

  # B. Prepare Sorted Gene Lists for RRHO2
  # Sorting from highest to lowest DDE score is mandatory for RRHO analysis
  gene_list1 <- rrho_input_data %>% 
    arrange(desc(score_human)) %>%
    select(Genes = human_symbol, DDE = score_human) %>% 
    as.data.frame()
    
  gene_list2 <- rrho_input_data %>% 
    arrange(desc(score_mouse)) %>%
    select(Genes = human_symbol, DDE = score_mouse) %>% 
    as.data.frame()

  # Identify the Biological Split Point (where DDE score crosses zero)
  # This marks the boundary between Up-regulated and Down-regulated genes
  split_h_val <- sum(gene_list1$DDE > 0)
  split_m_val <- sum(gene_list2$DDE > 0)

  # C. Execute RRHO2
  # Using 'try' to skip iterations that might encounter mathematical errors
  rrho_obj <- try(RRHO2_initialize(gene_list2, gene_list1, 
                                   labels = c("Mouse", "Human"), 
                                   boundary = 0.01,
                                   log10.ind = TRUE, 
                                   method = "hyper"), silent = TRUE)
  
  if(inherits(rrho_obj, "try-error")) next

  # Transform the hypermat (matrix) into a long format dataframe for ggplot2
  temp_df <- as.data.frame(rrho_obj$hypermat) %>%
    mutate(Mouse_Rank = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Mouse_Rank, names_to = "Human_Rank", values_to = "LogP") %>%
    mutate(
      Human_Rank = as.numeric(gsub("V", "", Human_Rank)),
      pathogen = curr_pathogen,       
      timepoint = curr_timepoint,
      # Store the split points to draw exact quadrant boundaries later
      split_h = split_h_val,
      split_m = split_m_val
    )

  all_rrho_results[[i]] <- temp_df
}

# Combine all results into a single final dataframe
final_rrho_df <- bind_rows(all_rrho_results)

# Save the processed data for visualization
final_rrho_df %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_rrho_df.rds"))
 

```

Extract RRHO2 results and gene lists by quadrant
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RRHO2) # Ensure the library is loaded

# 1. Identify all unique pathogen and timepoint combinations
combinations <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  distinct(pathogen, timepoint_comparison)

# 2. Initialize lists to store results
plot_data_list <- list()
gene_extraction_list <- list() # New list for the extracted genes
raw_objects_list <- list()

# --- MAIN LOOP ---
for(i in 1:nrow(combinations)) {
  
  curr_pathogen <- combinations$pathogen[i]
  curr_timepoint <- combinations$timepoint_comparison[i]
  # Create a unique name for each comparison
  iter_name <- paste(curr_pathogen, curr_timepoint, sep = "_")
  
  # --- A. Prepare Data ---
  rrho_input_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>% 
    filter(pathogen == curr_pathogen, timepoint_comparison == curr_timepoint) %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_adj_human), !is.na(p_adj_mouse), 
           !is.na(mean_log2fc_human), !is.na(mean_log2fc_mouse)) %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_human = ifelse(p_adj_human == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_adj_human),
      p_adj_mouse = ifelse(p_adj_mouse == 0, .Machine$double.xmin, p_adj_mouse),
      score_human = -log10(p_adj_human) * sign(mean_log2fc_human),
      score_mouse = -log10(p_adj_mouse) * sign(mean_log2fc_mouse)
    )

  if(nrow(rrho_input_data) < 100) next 

  gene_list_human <- rrho_input_data %>% 
    arrange(desc(score_human)) %>%
    select(Genes = human_symbol, DDE = score_human) %>% as.data.frame()
    
  gene_list_mouse <- rrho_input_data %>% 
    arrange(desc(score_mouse)) %>%
    select(Genes = human_symbol, DDE = score_mouse) %>% as.data.frame()

  split_human <- sum(gene_list_human$DDE > 0)
  split_mouse <- sum(gene_list_mouse$DDE > 0)

  # --- B. Execute RRHO2 ---
  rrho_obj <- try(RRHO2_initialize(gene_list_mouse, gene_list_human, 
                                   labels = c("Mouse", "Human"), 
                                   boundary = 0.01, log10.ind = TRUE, method = "hyper"), 
                  silent = TRUE)
  
  if(inherits(rrho_obj, "try-error")) next

  # Store the raw object
  raw_objects_list[[iter_name]] <- rrho_obj

  # --- C. Save Plot Data ---
  temp_df <- as.data.frame(rrho_obj$hypermat) %>%
    mutate(Mouse_Rank = row_number()) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Mouse_Rank, names_to = "Human_Rank", values_to = "LogP") %>%
    mutate(
      Human_Rank = as.numeric(gsub("V", "", Human_Rank)),
      pathogen = curr_pathogen,        
      timepoint = curr_timepoint,
      split_h = split_human,
      split_m = split_mouse
    )
  plot_data_list[[iter_name]] <- temp_df
}

# --- 3. CONSOLIDATE INTO final_results ---
final_results <- list(
  plot_data = bind_rows(plot_data_list),
  objects = raw_objects_list
)


#Extract gene lists
# 1. Define the quadrants we want to extract
quadrants <- c("uu", "dd", "ud", "du")

# 2. Use map_dfr to iterate through each comparison and quadrant
all_extracted_genes <- imap_dfr(final_results$objects, function(obj, condition_name) {
  
  # For each object (comparison), iterate through the 4 quadrants
  map_dfr(quadrants, function(q) {
    
    # Construct the internal names used by RRHO2 (e.g., genelist_uu and gene_list1_uu)
    genelist_slot <- paste0("genelist_", q)
    gene_item_slot <- paste0("gene_list1_", q)
    
    # Extract the list of genes
    genes <- obj[[genelist_slot]][[gene_item_slot]]
    
    # Only create a dataframe if there are genes in that quadrant
    if (!is.null(genes) && length(genes) > 0) {
      data.frame(
        genes = as.character(genes),
        condition = condition_name,
        comparison = genelist_slot,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  })
}) %>% 
  separate(condition, into = c("pathogen", "timepoint_comparison"), sep = "_") %>% 
  separate(comparison, into = c("del", "direction"), sep = "_") %>%
  select(-del) %>% 
  mutate(direction = case_when(direction == "uu" ~ "Up-Up",
                               direction == "ud" ~ "Up-Down",
                               direction == "dd" ~ "Down-Down",
                               direction == "du" ~ "Down-Up",
                               T~direction))


final_results_final = list(
  plotdata = final_results$plot_data, 
  rrho2_obj = final_results$objects, 
     genes = all_extracted_genes)


final_results_final %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_rrho_df.rds"))

```

```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
# Prepare data
rank_data <- human_mouse_log2fc_avg_wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_log2fc_human) | !is.na(mean_log2fc_mouse),
         !is.na(p_adj_human), !is.na(p_adj_mouse)) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>%
  mutate(
    score_human = -log10(p_adj_human) * sign(mean_log2fc_human),
    score_mouse = -log10(p_adj_mouse) * sign(mean_log2fc_mouse),
    Human_Rank_Val = rank(score_human),
    Mouse_Rank_Val = rank(score_mouse),
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(pathogen = as.character(pathogen),
    pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "Hepatitis B", "Staphylococcus aureus", "Escherichia coli", "Burn", "Trauma"))

# Calcular os limites por grupo
thresholds <- rank_data %>%
  group_by(pathogen, timepoint_comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    # Encontra o maior rank entre os genes com log2fc negativo
    v_line = max(Human_Rank_Val[mean_log2fc_human < 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    h_line = max(Mouse_Rank_Val[mean_log2fc_mouse < 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Plotar como Heatmap de Densidade (Raster)

                    axes = "all") +
 stat_density_2d(aes(fill = after_stat(density / sum(density))),

  scale_fill_gradientn(

) +
  scale_x_reverse(expand = c(0,0)) +

  # Divide by threshold
  geom_vline(data = thresholds, aes(xintercept = v_line), 
             linetype = "solid", color = "white", alpha = 1, linewidth = 2) +
  geom_hline(data = thresholds, aes(yintercept = h_line),
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
  mutate(cond = paste(pathogen, timepoint_direction, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(genes, cond, val) %>%
  distinct() %>%

  mutate(genes = factor(genes, levels = gene_order))
```

##### ORA: Hallmarks
```{r}

msigdbr_grouped = read_csv(file = here("tables", "Gene sets", "msigdb_hallmarks_grouped_genes.csv"))

#Discretize by quartile
ora_df_input = gene_list_df_heatmap %>% 
  mutate(condition = paste0(pathogen, "_", timepoint_comparison, "_", direction)) %>% 
  select(genes, condition)

term2gene_df_input = msigdbr_grouped %>% 
  select(process, genes = symbol)

#Run ORA Hallmarks
ora_all_diff_hallmark <- enricher_condition(
  df = ora_df_input,
  term2gene_df = term2gene_df_input) %>% 
  mutate(log_p_adjust = -log(p_adjust),
         process = str_replace_all(description, "_", " ")) %>% 
  separate(condition, into = c("pathogen", "timepoint_comparison", "direction"), sep = "_")  %>% 
  separate(timepoint_comparison, sep = "-", into = c("timepoint_mouse", "timepoint_human")) %>% 
  inner_join(msigdbr_grouped %>% 
               select(process, group) %>% 
               distinct(),
             by = join_by(id == "process")) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_mouse = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("Early", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         timepoint_human = fct_relevel(timepoint_mouse, c("Early", "2h", "4h", "6h", "12h", "24h", "Day 1", "Day 3", "Day 7")),
         pathogen = fct_relevel(pathogen, "Influenza", "HepB", "S. aureus", "E. coli", "Burn", "Trauma"),
         timepoint_direction = paste0(timepoint_mouse, " (", direction, ")")) %>% 
  arrange(fct_rev(direction), timepoint_mouse) %>% 
  mutate(timepoint_direction = fct_inorder(timepoint_direction)) 


ora_all_diff_hallmark2$timepoint_direction %>% levels()

#Save
ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  saveRDS(file = here("tables", "all_human_mouse_rrho_ora_hallmark.rds"))

#Print
ora_all_diff_hallmark
  
```


```{r}
# Clustering
df_to_cluster <- ora_all_diff_hallmark %>%
  mutate(val = case_when(
    direction == "Up-Up"     ~  2,
    direction == "Up-Down"   ~  1,
    direction == "Down-Up"   ~ -1,
    direction == "Down-Down" ~ -2,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )) %>%
  select(description, timepoint_direction, pathogen, val) %>%
  mutate(cond = paste(pathogen, timepoint_direction, sep = "_")) %>%
  select(description, cond, val) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cond, values_from = val, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("description")

gene_dist <- dist(as.matrix(df_to_cluster)) 
gene_hclust <- hclust(gene_dist, method = "ward.D2")

# 3. Extrair a ordem dos description clusterizados
gene_order <- rownames(df_to_cluster)[gene_hclust$order]

# 4. Aplicar a ordem de volta ao dataframe original do ggplot
ora_all_diff_hallmark_clustered <- ora_all_diff_hallmark %>%
  mutate(description = factor(description, levels = gene_order))
```




```{r fig.height=8, fig.width=20}
ora_all_diff_hallmark_heatmap = ora_all_diff_hallmark %>% 
  mutate(direction = fct_relevel(direction, "Up-Up", "Down-Down", "Up-Down", "Down-Up")) %>% 
  filter(log_p_adjust > 1) %>% 
  mutate(log_p_adjust = if_else(log_p_adjust >10, 10, log_p_adjust)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = timepoint_mouse ,
      y = description) +
  # facet_grid(~direction+pathogen, space = "free_x", scales = "free_x") +
    facet_nested_wrap(~direction+pathogen, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = log_p_adjust)) +
  theme_vaxgo() + 
  labs(x = "",
       y = "") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, size =8),
        axis.text.x= element_text(size =8, angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
        # axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5,size = 10, color = "white", face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, size = 8),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "black", color = "white"),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linetype = 1, color = "gray90"), 
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = 1, color = "gray90"), 
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0.3, 0, 0.3, unit = "cm"),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
        axis.line.y.right = element_line(linetype = 1, size = 0.5, color = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10, 
                                   # hjust = 1, vjust = 1, 
                                   angle = 0),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        ggh4x.facet.nestline = element_line(colour = "white", linetype = 1))  +
   scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#4361ee", 
    high = "#46eec6",
    limits = c(0, 10),
    breaks = c(0, 1, 1.3, 2, 10), 
    labels = c("0", "1", "1.3", "2", "≥10"), 
    na.value = "white"
  )
```
